1	import Mathlib
     2	
     3	/-!
     4	Statement of the real-arithmetic update-form block Jacobi theorem from
     5	`/spec/source.txt` (theorem:block_jacobi_real). The definitions are executable
     6	mathematical constructions; only the final theorem is left for the proof role.
     7	-/
     8	
     9	open scoped BigOperators Matrix
    10	open Filter Topology
    11	open scoped ENNReal NNReal
    12	
    13	namespace Research.BlockJacobi
    14	
    15	abbrev Vector (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℝ
    16	abbrev RealMatrix (n : ℕ) := Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ
    17	
    18	/-- A coordinate partition specifies arbitrary, possibly unequal block sizes.
    19	Unused block labels have no effect. -/
    20	def IsBlockDecomposition {n : ℕ} {B : Type*} (block : Fin n → B)
    21	    (A D N : RealMatrix n) : Prop :=
    22	  A = D + N ∧
    23	    (∀ i j, block i ≠ block j → D i j = 0) ∧
    24	    (∀ i j, block i = block j → N i j = 0)
    25	
    26	/-- The maximum absolute coordinate, with value zero in dimension zero. -/
    27	noncomputable def vectorInfNorm {n : ℕ} (v : Vector n) : ℝ :=
    28	  ↑(Finset.univ.sup fun i => ‖v i‖₊)
    29	
    30	/-- The induced infinity norm: maximum absolute row sum, not maximum entry. -/
    31	noncomputable def matrixInfNorm {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) : ℝ :=
    32	  ↑(Finset.univ.sup fun i => ∑ j, ‖M i j‖₊)
    33	
    34	def vectorAbs {n : ℕ} (v : Vector n) : Vector n := fun i => |v i|
    35	
    36	def matrixAbs {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) : RealMatrix n := fun i j => |M i j|
    37	
    38	/-- Complexification retains all complex eigenvalues of the real matrix. -/
    39	noncomputable def complexification {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ :=
    40	  M.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)
    41	
    42	/-- The usual complex spectral radius. It is finite for finite matrices; the
    43	empty-dimensional spectrum has radius zero by the supremum convention. -/
    44	noncomputable def rho {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) : ℝ :=
    45	  (spectralRadius ℂ (complexification M)).toReal
    46	
    47	noncomputable def iterationMatrix {n : ℕ} (D N : RealMatrix n) : RealMatrix n :=
    48	  -(D⁻¹ * N)
    49	
    50	/-- Correction computed from the residual at the current approximation. -/
    51	noncomputable def correctionAt {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n)
    52	    (b y : Vector n) : Vector n :=
    53	  D⁻¹ *ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ y)
    54	
    55	noncomputable def update {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n)
    56	    (b y : Vector n) : Vector n :=
    57	  y + correctionAt A D b y
    58	
    59	/-- Exact update-form Jacobi iteration for an arbitrary initial guess. -/
    60	noncomputable def iterate {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n)
    61	    (b x₀ : Vector n) : ℕ → Vector n
    62	  | 0 => x₀
    63	  | k + 1 => update A D b (iterate A D b x₀ k)
    64	
    65	/-- `correction ... k` denotes the paper's correction c^(k+1). -/
    66	noncomputable def correction {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n)
    67	    (b x₀ : Vector n) (k : ℕ) : Vector n :=
    68	  correctionAt A D b (iterate A D b x₀ k)
    69	
    70	noncomputable def error {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n)
    71	    (b x x₀ : Vector n) (k : ℕ) : Vector n :=
    72	  iterate A D b x₀ k - x
    73	
    74	lemma update_sub {n : ℕ} (A D N : RealMatrix n) (b : Vector n)
    75	    (hA : A = D + N) (hD : IsUnit D.det) (u v : Vector n) :
    76	    update A D b u - update A D b v = iterationMatrix D N *ᵥ (u - v) := by
    77	  have hi : D⁻¹ * D = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul D hD
    78	  unfold update correctionAt iterationMatrix
    79	  rw [hA, Matrix.neg_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_sub,
    80	    Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec]
    81	  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hi,
    82	    Matrix.one_mulVec]
    83	  abel
    84	
    85	lemma update_fixed {n : ℕ} (A D : RealMatrix n) (b x : Vector n)
    86	    (hx : A *ᵥ x = b) : update A D b x = x := by
    87	  simp [update, correctionAt, hx]
    88	
    89	lemma error_step {n : ℕ} (A D N : RealMatrix n) (b x x₀ : Vector n)
    90	    (hA : A = D + N) (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hx : A *ᵥ x = b) (k : ℕ) :
    91	    error A D b x x₀ (k+1) = iterationMatrix D N *ᵥ error A D b x x₀ k := by
    92	  simpa only [error, iterate, update_fixed A D b x hx] using
    93	    update_sub A D N b hA hD (iterate A D b x₀ k) x
    94	
    95	lemma error_power {n : ℕ} (A D N : RealMatrix n) (b x x₀ : Vector n)
    96	    (hA : A = D + N) (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hx : A *ᵥ x = b) (k : ℕ) :
    97	    error A D b x x₀ k = iterationMatrix D N ^ k *ᵥ (x₀ - x) := by
    98	  induction k with
    99	  | zero => simp [error, iterate]
   100	  | succ k ih => rw [error_step A D N b x x₀ hA hD hx, ih, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, pow_succ']
   101	
   102	lemma abs_mulVec_le {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) (v : Vector n) (i : Fin n) :
   103	    vectorAbs (M *ᵥ v) i ≤ (matrixAbs M *ᵥ vectorAbs v) i := by
   104	  simp only [vectorAbs, matrixAbs, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
   105	  exact (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans_eq (by simp [abs_mul])
   106	
   107	lemma abs_power_le {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) (v : Vector n) (k : ℕ) :
   108	    ∀ i, vectorAbs (M ^ k *ᵥ v) i ≤ (matrixAbs M ^ k *ᵥ vectorAbs v) i := by
   109	  induction k with
   110	  | zero => simp [vectorAbs]
   111	  | succ k ih =>
   112	    rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
   113	    intro i
   114	    refine (abs_mulVec_le _ _ i).trans ?_
   115	    change (∑ j, |M i j| * vectorAbs (M ^ k *ᵥ v) j) ≤
   116	      ∑ j, |M i j| * (matrixAbs M ^ k *ᵥ vectorAbs v) j
   117	    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih j) (abs_nonneg _)
   118	
   119	open scoped Matrix.Norms.Operator in
   120	lemma inf_mulVec_le {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) (v : Vector n) :
   121	    vectorInfNorm (M *ᵥ v) ≤ matrixInfNorm M * vectorInfNorm v := by
   122	  change ‖M *ᵥ v‖ ≤ _
   123	  rw [show matrixInfNorm M = ‖M‖ from (Matrix.linfty_opNorm_def M).symm]
   124	  exact Matrix.linfty_opNorm_mulVec M v
   125	
   126	lemma inf_nonneg {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) : 0 ≤ matrixInfNorm M := NNReal.coe_nonneg _
   127	
   128	lemma inf_power_le {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) (v : Vector n) (k : ℕ) :
   129	    vectorInfNorm (M ^ k *ᵥ v) ≤ matrixInfNorm M ^ k * vectorInfNorm v := by
   130	  induction k with
   131	  | zero => simp
   132	  | succ k ih =>
   133	    rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, pow_succ']
   134	    exact (inf_mulVec_le _ _).trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (inf_nonneg M)).trans_eq (mul_assoc ..).symm)
   135	
   136	lemma rho_neg {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) : rho (-M) = rho M := by
   137	  have hc : complexification (-M) = -complexification M := by ext i j; simp [complexification]
   138	  unfold rho
   139	  rw [hc]
   140	  congr 1
   141	  simp only [spectralRadius, ← spectrum.neg_eq, Set.mem_neg]
   142	  apply le_antisymm
   143	  · refine iSup₂_le fun z hz => ?_
   144	    simpa using (le_iSup₂_of_le (-z) hz (by simp))
   145	  · refine iSup₂_le fun z hz => ?_
   146	    simpa using (le_iSup₂_of_le (-z) (by simpa using hz) (by simp))
   147	
   148	open scoped Matrix.Norms.Operator in
   149	lemma complex_power_criterion {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
   150	    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => M ^ k) atTop (𝓝 0) ↔ spectralRadius ℂ M < 1 := by
   151	  have hf : spectralRadius ℂ M ≠ ∞ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.coe_ne_top
   152	    (spectrum.spectralRadius_le_nnnorm M)
   153	  constructor
   154	  · intro h
   155	    obtain ⟨k, hk, hn⟩ :=
   156	      ((h.norm.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (show ‖(0 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)‖ < 1 by simp))).and
   157	        (eventually_gt_atTop 0)).exists
   158	    have hp : spectralRadius ℂ M ^ k < 1 :=
   159	      (spectrum.spectralRadius_pow_le' M k).trans_lt
   160	        ((spectrum.spectralRadius_le_nnnorm (M ^ k)).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hk))
   161	    by_contra hh
   162	    exact (not_lt_of_ge (one_le_pow₀ (le_of_not_gt hh))) hp
   163	  · intro h
   164	    have hr : (spectralRadius ℂ M).toReal < 1 := by
   165	      simpa using (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal hf ENNReal.one_ne_top).mpr h
   166	    obtain ⟨r, hr₁, hr₂⟩ := exists_between hr
   167	    have rpos : 0 ≤ r := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg.trans hr₁.le
   168	    have ht : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ‖M ^ k‖ ^ (1 / k : ℝ)) atTop
   169	        (𝓝 (spectralRadius ℂ M).toReal) := by
   170	      have := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal hf).comp
   171	        (spectrum.pow_norm_pow_one_div_tendsto_nhds_spectralRadius M)
   172	      simpa only [Function.comp_def, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)] using this
   173	    apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
   174	    apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun k => norm_nonneg (M ^ k)) _
   175	      (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one rpos hr₂)
   176	    filter_upwards [ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hr₁), eventually_gt_atTop 0] with k hk hn
   177	    have he : (‖M ^ k‖ ^ (1 / k : ℝ)) ^ k = ‖M ^ k‖ := by
   178	      simpa only [one_div] using Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow (norm_nonneg (M ^ k)) (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
   179	    rw [← he]
   180	    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) hk.le k
   181	
   182	lemma complexification_pow {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) (k : ℕ) :
   183	    complexification (M ^ k) = complexification M ^ k :=
   184	  Matrix.map_pow M (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) k
   185	
   186	open scoped Matrix.Norms.Operator in
   187	lemma real_power_criterion {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) :
   188	    (∀ v : Vector n, Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => M ^ k *ᵥ v) atTop (𝓝 0)) ↔ rho M < 1 := by
   189	  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty (Fin n) with
   190	  | inl h =>
   191	    have hs : spectralRadius ℂ (complexification M) = 0 := by
   192	      simp [spectralRadius, spectrum.of_subsingleton]
   193	    simp only [rho, hs, ENNReal.toReal_zero, zero_lt_one, iff_true]
   194	    intro v
   195	    have he : (fun k : ℕ => M ^ k *ᵥ v) = fun _ => (0 : Vector n) := by
   196	      funext k; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
   197	    rw [he]
   198	    exact tendsto_const_nhds
   199	  | inr h =>
   200	    have hf : spectralRadius ℂ (complexification M) ≠ ∞ :=
   201	      ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.coe_ne_top (spectrum.spectralRadius_le_nnnorm _)
   202	    rw [rho, ← ENNReal.toReal_one, ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal hf ENNReal.one_ne_top,
   203	      ← complex_power_criterion]
   204	    have he (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) : (complexification M ^ k) i j = ((M ^ k) i j : ℂ) := by
   205	      rw [← complexification_pow]; rfl
   206	    constructor
   207	    · intro hv
   208	      apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
   209	      intro i
   210	      apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
   211	      intro j
   212	      have ht := tendsto_pi_nhds.mp (hv (Pi.single j 1)) i
   213	      have ht' : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (M ^ k) i j) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
   214	        simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_single_one, Matrix.col_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using ht
   215	      change Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (complexification M ^ k) i j) atTop (𝓝 0)
   216	      simp_rw [he]
   217	      exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht'
   218	    · intro hc v
   219	      apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
   220	      intro i
   221	      have ht : ∀ j, Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (M ^ k) i j) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
   222	        intro j
   223	        have ht := tendsto_pi_nhds.mp (tendsto_pi_nhds.mp hc i) j
   224	        change Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (complexification M ^ k) i j) atTop (𝓝 0) at ht
   225	        simp_rw [he] at ht
   226	        simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.zero_re] using
   227	          Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht
   228	      simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero] using
   229	        tendsto_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ => (ht j).mul_const (v j))

   231	lemma convergence_iff {n : ℕ} (A D N : RealMatrix n) (b x : Vector n)
   232	    (hA : A = D + N) (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hx : A *ᵥ x = b) :
   233	    (∀ x₀ : Vector n, Tendsto (iterate A D b x₀) atTop (𝓝 x)) ↔
   234	      rho (iterationMatrix D N) < 1 := by
   235	  have hi (x₀ : Vector n) (k : ℕ) : iterate A D b x₀ k =
   236	      iterationMatrix D N ^ k *ᵥ (x₀ - x) + x := by
   237	    exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp (error_power A D N b x x₀ hA hD hx k)
   238	  rw [← real_power_criterion]
   239	  constructor
   240	  · intro h v
   241	    have ht := (h (v + x)).sub_const x
   242	    simpa only [hi, add_sub_cancel_right, sub_self] using ht
   243	  · intro h x₀
   244	    have ht := (h (x₀ - x)).add_const x
   245	    simpa only [zero_add, ← hi] using ht
   246	
   247	lemma norm_suffices {n : ℕ} (M : RealMatrix n) (hM : matrixInfNorm M < 1) :
   248	    ∀ v : Vector n, Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => M ^ k *ᵥ v) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
   249	  intro v
   250	  apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
   251	  change Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => vectorInfNorm (M ^ k *ᵥ v)) atTop (𝓝 0)
   252	  apply squeeze_zero (fun k => NNReal.coe_nonneg _) (fun k => inf_power_le M v k)
   253	  simpa only [zero_mul] using
   254	    (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (inf_nonneg M) hM).mul_const (vectorInfNorm v)
   255	
   256	/-- Full selected result, with the update equations, both error identities,
   257	both bounds, the spectral-radius criterion for every initial guess, and the
   258	infinity-norm sufficient condition and contraction estimate.
   259	
   260	No invertibility of A, positivity, symmetry, or convergence is assumed.
   261	All natural dimensions, including zero, and arbitrary block partitions are allowed.
   262	-/
   263	theorem block_jacobi_real
   264	    {n : ℕ} {B : Type*} (block : Fin n → B)
   265	    (A D N : RealMatrix n) (b x : Vector n)
   266	    (hblocks : IsBlockDecomposition block A D N)
   267	    (hD : IsUnit D.det) (hx : A *ᵥ x = b) :
   268	    (∀ (x₀ : Vector n) (k : ℕ),
   269	      D *ᵥ correction A D b x₀ k = b - A *ᵥ iterate A D b x₀ k ∧
   270	      iterate A D b x₀ (k + 1) = iterate A D b x₀ k + correction A D b x₀ k ∧
   271	      error A D b x x₀ (k + 1) = iterationMatrix D N *ᵥ error A D b x x₀ k ∧
   272	      error A D b x x₀ k = iterationMatrix D N ^ k *ᵥ error A D b x x₀ 0 ∧
   273	      (∀ i, vectorAbs (error A D b x x₀ k) i ≤
   274	        ((matrixAbs (iterationMatrix D N)) ^ k *ᵥ
   275	          vectorAbs (error A D b x x₀ 0)) i) ∧
   276	      vectorInfNorm (error A D b x x₀ k) ≤
   277	        matrixInfNorm (iterationMatrix D N) ^ k *
   278	          vectorInfNorm (error A D b x x₀ 0)) ∧
   279	    rho (iterationMatrix D N) = rho (D⁻¹ * N) ∧
   280	    ((∀ x₀ : Vector n, Tendsto (iterate A D b x₀) atTop (𝓝 x)) ↔
   281	      rho (iterationMatrix D N) < 1) ∧
   282	    (matrixInfNorm (iterationMatrix D N) < 1 →
   283	      (∀ x₀ : Vector n, Tendsto (iterate A D b x₀) atTop (𝓝 x)) ∧
   284	      0 ≤ matrixInfNorm (iterationMatrix D N) ∧
   285	      (∀ u v : Vector n,
   286	        vectorInfNorm (update A D b u - update A D b v) ≤
   287	          matrixInfNorm (iterationMatrix D N) * vectorInfNorm (u - v))) := by
   288	  have hA := hblocks.1
   289	  refine ⟨?_, rho_neg (D⁻¹ * N), convergence_iff A D N b x hA hD hx, ?_⟩
   290	  · intro x₀ k
   291	    refine ⟨?_, rfl, error_step A D N b x x₀ hA hD hx k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   292	    · unfold correction correctionAt
   293	      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv D hD, Matrix.one_mulVec]
   294	    · simpa only [error, iterate] using error_power A D N b x x₀ hA hD hx k
   295	    · rw [error_power A D N b x x₀ hA hD hx k]
   296	      simpa only [error, iterate] using abs_power_le (iterationMatrix D N) (x₀ - x) k
   297	    · rw [error_power A D N b x x₀ hA hD hx k]
   298	      simpa only [error, iterate] using inf_power_le (iterationMatrix D N) (x₀ - x) k
   299	  · intro hM
   300	    refine ⟨(convergence_iff A D N b x hA hD hx).mpr
   301	      ((real_power_criterion _).mp (norm_suffices _ hM)), inf_nonneg _, ?_⟩
   302	    intro u v
   303	    rw [update_sub A D N b hA hD]
   304	    exact inf_mulVec_le _ _
   305	
   306	end Research.BlockJacobi
